items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, calm and serene, no people, no text, no logos. A tidy American bedroom arranged with feng shui principles: a queen bed with a solid upholstered headboard placed against a solid wall (no window behind it), positioned so the bedroom door is visible from the bed but not directly in line with the foot of the bed, equal walking space on both sides, two matching oak nightstands with matching warm lamps, linen bedding in soft earth tones (sand, sage, warm white), a jute rug, a single calm landscape print above the bed with no text, nothing stored under the bed. Soft natural daylight from a side window with linen curtains. The door is partly visible at the side.
